cases.oracle_rationale: Owner verifier confirms exact bytes; producer is authorized; semantic report is passed; scope and receiver time are bound.

mutations: Mutate one raw report byte while preserving its declared digest and length.
Retain an otherwise valid owner receipt for the original report bytes.
cases.oracle_rationale: The owner verifier recomputes the raw artifact digest over supplied bytes; a previously valid receipt for different bytes cannot compensate.

mutations: Change declared byte length without changing the supplied payload.
cases.oracle_rationale: The owner byte verifier checks both length and digest.

mutations: Present a cryptographically valid signature from a producer not authorized for this report role and scope.
cases.oracle_rationale: Cryptographic validity and organizational authorization are separate checks.

mutations: Keep artifact bytes valid but remove the owner authority resolution receipt.
cases.oracle_rationale: A missing authority proof is not a positive or a rejection of the underlying physical proposition.

mutations: Modify signed report bytes after signing while keeping the signer key identifier unchanged.
cases.oracle_rationale: The signature verifier must bind the signed statement to the exact raw artifact commitment.

mutations: Use a signing key whose revocation was effective and known under the pinned historical trust snapshot.
cases.oracle_rationale: Key validity is assessed under the pinned policy snapshot, not a caller-supplied current status.

mutations: Use a valid producer identity and role whose authority scope excludes this report type or claim class.
cases.oracle_rationale: A role label alone does not prove authority for this particular statement.

mutations: Bind an otherwise valid report to a different physical unit serial or article identity.
cases.oracle_rationale: Exact physical subject identity must match the typed decision context and owner packet.

mutations: Substitute configuration revision or operating-envelope reference while preserving the report digest.
cases.oracle_rationale: Model report applicability cannot be borrowed across configuration or operating-envelope contexts.

mutations: Change solver build or solver-configuration digest while retaining the original model report.
cases.oracle_rationale: Solver and executable configuration are part of the model identity envelope.

mutations: Replace the raw report artifact digest with the digest of the normalized typed model cut.
cases.oracle_rationale: Raw source bytes and normalized AERO cut are different objects with distinct identities.

mutations: Supply strong in-domain metrics while the requested claim is outside the declared validated operating domain.
cases.oracle_rationale: Good results in one domain cannot expand a model's qualified domain.

mutations: Remove an owner-required validation modality while keeping other modalities passed.
cases.oracle_rationale: Validation modalities are owner-defined; one modality cannot compensate for another required modality.

mutations: Remove one required metric/stratum report while all remaining strata pass.
cases.oracle_rationale: A missing required stratum cannot be averaged away by other strata.

mutations: Introduce overlap between development/calibration and confirmatory units or groups.
cases.oracle_rationale: The split-integrity owner result is a hard obligation, not a score penalty.

mutations: Keep the validation package present but leave the independent-reference identity or evidence unverified.
cases.oracle_rationale: A supplied reference locator does not demonstrate an independently verified reference.

mutations: Set receiver-first-seen after the requested historical evidence cutoff while issuer time is earlier.
cases.oracle_rationale: A later-received artifact cannot enter the original historical evidence view.

mutations: Backdate issuer-recorded time.
Keep independently observed receiver-first-seen after the evidence cutoff.
cases.oracle_rationale: Issuer-declared recorded time is not receiver-observed first-seen time; a backdated assertion cannot move the receipt frontier.

mutations: Advance a model-report dependency resource generation and leave a descendant receipt pinned to the prior generation.
Substitute the decision context risk-classification digest.
cases.oracle_rationale: The owner freshness blocker and context substitution remain independently visible; the context mismatch cannot be compensated by an otherwise valid model report.

mutations: Declare an unobserved dependency channel or unresolved input while no observed resource has changed.
cases.oracle_rationale: Unknown dependency coverage is itself non-positive; absence of an observed change is not proof of no change.

mutations: Change a resource proven unrelated to this claim under a qualified complete dependency scope.
cases.oracle_rationale: The exact affected-claim frontier changes, while a disjoint claim's evidence remains valid; this is conditional on qualified complete observation.

mutations: Present two different payload digests under one source-scoped artifact identity and one owner authority.
cases.oracle_rationale: Conflicting payloads for one source-scoped identity must not be treated as independent corroboration or silently selected.

mutations: A later-received revocation is backdated to before the claim cutoff; compare all three temporal replay modes.
cases.oracle_rationale: The original as-known report remains reproducible; trust-only and current-evidence/current-trust replays must produce the newly qualified adverse disposition.
